actions.description: Create a Zendesk Help Center category
actions.name: create-category

name.description: The name of the category. Example: "Getting Started"

locale.description: The locale where the category is displayed. Example: "en-us"

position.description: The position of this category relative to other categories

actions.description: Create an organization in Zendesk Support
actions.name: create-organization

actions.description: Create a Zendesk Help Center section
actions.name: create-section

category_id.description: The ID of the category to which this section belongs. Example: 123

name.description: The name of the section. Example: "Getting Started"

locale.description: The locale in which the section is displayed. Example: "en-us"

description.description: The description of the section. Example: "Articles about getting started"

position.description: The position of this section in the section list. Used when sorting is set to manual.

parent_section_id.description: The ID of the parent section. Only writable for Guide Enterprise customers.

theme_template.description: The theme template name used to display this section in Help Center.

actions.description: Create a support ticket in Zendesk
actions.name: create-ticket

subject.description: The subject of the ticket. Example: "My printer is on fire!"

comment.description: The initial comment on the ticket. Example: "The printer caught fire when I tried to print a document."

requester_email.description: Email of the requester. If no user exists with this email, a new user will be created. Example: "customer@example.com"

requester_name.description: Name of the requester. Only used when creating a new user. Example: "John Doe"

tags.description: Tags applied to the ticket. Example: ["printer", "urgent"]

actions.description: Create a user in Zendesk Support.
actions.name: create-user

name.description: The full name of the user. Example: "John Doe"

email.description: The primary email address of the user. Example: "john@example.com"

phone.description: The phone number of the user. Example: "+1234567890"

role.description: The role of the user. Example: "end-user"

external_id.description: A unique identifier from your external system. Example: "ext-123"

locale.description: The locale of the user. Example: "en-US"

signature.description: The signature of the agent/admin. Example: "Best regards, John"

details.description: Details about the user. Example: "VIP customer"

notes.description: Notes about the user. Example: "Acquired through referral"

organization_id.description: The ID of the organization the user belongs to. Example: 123

verified.description: Whether the user has been verified. Example: true

suspended.description: Whether the user is suspended. Example: false

id.description: The ID of the created user. Example: 123

name.description: The name of the created user. Example: "John Doe"

email.description: The email of the created user. Example: "john@example.com"

phone.description: The phone of the created user. Example: "+1234567890"

role.description: The role of the created user. Example: "end-user"

external_id.description: The external ID of the created user. Example: "ext-123"

locale.description: The locale of the created user. Example: "en-US"

signature.description: The signature of the created user. Example: "Best regards, John"

details.description: The details of the created user. Example: "VIP customer"

notes.description: The notes of the created user. Example: "Acquired through referral"

organization_id.description: The organization ID of the created user. Example: 123

active.description: Whether the created user is active. Example: true

verified.description: Whether the created user is verified. Example: true

suspended.description: Whether the created user is suspended. Example: false

actions.description: Delete a Zendesk user
actions.name: delete-user

userId.description: The ID of the user to delete. Example: "1234567890"

success.description: Whether the user was successfully deleted

userId.description: The ID of the deleted user

actions.description: Search tickets with Zendesk search syntax.

query.description: Zendesk search query. Should include "type:ticket" and any additional filters like status, tags, dates. Example: "type:ticket status:open"

actions.description: Update an existing organization in Zendesk.
actions.name: update-organization

organizationId.description: The ID of the organization to update. Example: 123

name.description: A unique name for the organization. Example: "Acme Inc."

notes.description: Any notes about the organization. Set to null to clear. Example: "Primary customer"

details.description: Any details about the organization, such as the address. Set to null to clear.

external_id.description: A unique external ID to associate organizations to an external record. Set to null to clear.

group_id.description: New tickets from users in this organization are automatically put in this group. Example: 234

shared_tickets.description: End users in this organization can see each other's tickets.

shared_comments.description: End users in this organization can comment on each other's tickets.

domain_names.description: An array of domain names associated with this organization. Example: ["example.com", "acme.com"]

tags.description: The tags of the organization. Example: ["vip", "enterprise"]

actions.description: Update an existing ticket and optionally add a comment
actions.name: update-ticket

ticket_id.description: The ID of the ticket to update. Example: 12345

assignee_id.description: The ID of the agent to assign the ticket to.

group_id.description: The ID of the group to assign the ticket to.

requester_id.description: The ID of the requester (end user) of the ticket.

tags.description: Array of tags to apply to the ticket.

custom_fields.description: Array of custom field objects with id and value.

id.description: The ID of the custom field.

value.description: The value to set for the custom field.

comment.description: Optional comment to add when updating the ticket.

body.description: The body of the comment. Example: "This issue has been resolved."

public.description: Whether the comment is public (visible to requester) or internal. Default: true

author_id.description: The ID of the user who authored the comment. Defaults to the authenticated user.

actions.description: Update an existing user.
actions.name: update-user

userId.description: The ID of the user to update. Example: "123456789"

email.description: The user's email address. On update, adds as secondary email if primary is verified.

alias.description: An alias displayed to end users.

details.description: Any details you want to store about the user, such as an address.

notes.description: Any notes you want to store about the user.

organizationId.description: The ID of the user's organization.

customRoleId.description: A custom role ID if the user is an agent on Enterprise plan.

defaultGroupId.description: The ID of the user's default group.

externalId.description: A unique identifier from another system.

localeId.description: The language identifier for this user.

timeZone.description: The time-zone of this user. Example: "America/New_York".

verified.description: Whether any of the user's identities is verified.

userFields.description: Custom fields values for the user's profile.

remotePhotoUrl.description: A URL pointing to the user's profile picture.
